messages:
lee: hey team, lee here — onboarding day 2. trying to kick off the infra/ci pipeline from my fork. Buildkite job fails pulling the runner image (403) and the GitHub Actions step also errors. any onboarding gotchas?

oya: welcome! :wave: usually two things: GHCR auth (GitHub App vs PAT) and our policy that prevents forks from using org secrets in GH Actions. what does the error say?

lee: Buildkite agent log:
```
failed to pull image "ghcr.io/redwood/ci-runner:main": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to resolve reference: 403
{"message":"access denied: You must have read access to the container registry."}
```
GH Actions log: 
```
Error: Repository does not have access to read packages. The token does not have the required permissions.
```

charlie: for Buildkite we rely on the org GitHub App token bound to the main repo. forks won't inherit that. For Actions, we intentionally don't expose secrets to fork PRs (security). So two separate failure modes.

sandra: I can add you to the ci-runners Okta group so Buildkite has the masked CI_GHCR_TOKEN for your builds. I can also grant a temporary PAT for local testing if needed. Want me to do that?

lee: please add me to the group, that should unblock Buildkite. for GH Actions i can open a PR against the main repo to run the integration job there (or we can make the pipeline fall back to a public runner image for forks).

infra-bot: Access request created: CI-9009 assigned to infra-oncall. Status: pending.

sandra: added lee to ci-runners and set masked env var CI_GHCR_TOKEN on his pipeline. also pasted this onboarding doc: https://docs.redwood/infrastructure/onboarding#ci-forks-ghcr

lee: restarted Buildkite job — ✅ build passed! GH Actions still blocked but i'll create the PR to run the sensitive test in main.

oya: sweet. long-term we want the pipeline to gracefully fallback to a public image for forks and document the PAT/workflow differences. i've added a note to the onboarding checklist. welcome aboard! :tada:
